name.en: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
name.hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना

description.en: National Social Assistance Programme pension support for eligible widows.

benefits.note: These are central contributions, not necessarily the total pension paid; states may add their own contribution.

eligibility_rules.note: Higher central contribution category; state implementation must be checked.

application.channel: State/UT social welfare or NSAP implementing authority
application.instructions: Application and documents are administered through the State/UT. Confirm the current state process before advising a user.

grievance.instructions: Use the State/UT designated grievance and social audit mechanism; confirm local authority and current escalation path.

sources.title: NSAP scheme-wise eligibility and central assistance
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
sources.supports: IGNWPS central eligibility band and central contribution

sources.title: Recent NSAP scheme update
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
sources.supports: Confirms widow pension scheme continues in existing form in the reported update

verification.warning: A scheme-level status does not establish an individual's eligibility. Confirm the current state/UT implementation and official beneficiary record.

notes: The central amount is a contribution and should not be represented as the beneficiary's total pension.
State-specific eligibility, application and total pension amount must be stored separately.
